messages:
alex.harper: Quick sync — HelioMaps POC kickoff. They asked for three prioritized user journeys, SSO + SOC2 answers, and a 6-week timeline. @maria.ng can you confirm which endpoints we'll expose? @lee_dev need perf targets. @dylan_sec can you check security Qs?

maria.ng: Proposed endpoints: /v1/generate (labels & route summaries), /v1/embedding (POI similarity), /v1/re-rank (route options). Keep payload minimal; use system messages + few-shot templates for consistent outputs. Happy to own prompt set. :white_check_mark:

lee_dev: Perf SLOs suggestion: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for short prompts (<256 tokens). Embeddings: target batch size 16, throughput ~200 qps for the POC. If they need predictability, recommend Dedicated pool or a private deployment. Hosted with shared capacity might be noisy.

dylan_sec: Security notes: SAML SSO ok — we'll need IdP metadata. Data retention: default 30 days for logs, option to disable KV caching for sensitive flows. SOC2 report available; need to confirm scoping for HelioMaps (are they storing PII in prompts?). I can draft answers for the questionnaire.

alex.harper: Pricing ask from the customer — can we give a ballpark for a 6-week POC with ~50k gen tokens/day and ~20k embedding tokens/day? Also they asked about private deployment vs hosted.

maria.ng: Rough hosted estimate: $4k–$6k for the 6 weeks if using a small dedicated pool + burst. On-prem/private: large one-time setup fee (>$40k) plus infra. Model choice matters — I recommend a quantized 6B variant for balance of latency/cost and output quality.

lee_dev: Implementation snippet for the POC routing/config (for infra and devs):
```json
{
  "routes": ["/generate","/embedding","/rerank"],
  "canary": "10% -> small-model",
  "batching": {"embeddings": 16},
  "cache": "prefix-kv-enabled"
}
```

dylan_sec: From the security questionnaire — quick draft answers to drop in their doc:
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit.
- Access control: Role-based access + SCIM provisioning.
- Logging: Audit logs available and exportable to customer S3.
- Data handling: Option to disable caching and set retention to 0 days for sensitive projects.
I'll upload the full Q&A to the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/heliomaps/sec-qna

alex.harper: Customer success criteria they shared: 
- Accuracy: route summarization ROUGE-L > 0.60 vs human baseline.
- Latency: p95 < 350ms for generation.
- UX: >=80% prompts produce acceptable label length & format (manual spot-check).
- Integration: SSO + ingest sample dataset + searchable embeddings.
If we meet these, they sign pilot contract.

maria.ng: For evals I propose: 200 test prompts per journey (geocode assist, route summarization, label gen), automated metrics + 20 manual spot checks per journey. I can assemble prompt sets and baseline answers by Wednesday.

ops-bot: Demo env provisioned -> https://staging.redwood/heliomaps (creds via 1Password). :rocket:

alex.harper: Next steps / owners:
1) maria.ng: prompt sets + endpoints + eval plan by Wed.
2) lee_dev: infra sizing + deterministic cost estimate (hosted vs private) by Thu.
3) dylan_sec: security Qs + mandatory blockers list by Thu EOD.
4) I will draft the SOW + 6-week timeline and send to HelioMaps.

Thanks all — this looks doable if nothing else hard-blocks (on-prem requirement or restricted PII). :pray:
